title: Bill of materials, M96.03 rebuild as a 4.0 l with LN Engineering machining
basis: LN Engineering M96.03 Standard/Deluxe rebuild kit contents as carried in parts.json, the LN M96/M97 Nickies Program 2026 (SKU list), the parts catalogue Kat 021 (24.07.2017) for Porsche part numbers and model-year limits.
rules: Group A is bought from or done by LN Engineering because the item is in-house or part of the machining package.
Group B is bought by Porsche part number wherever the price is best (Gaudin, FCP Euro, SSF, Worldpac, Rusnak, RockAuto). Where two numbers are listed, Gaudin settles which one is current.
Group C is still good until a measurement says otherwise.
Group D is not needed because of the 4.0 l conversion or the LN package.
Prices are shown only where a listed price exists and name their source. Everything else is null until the price agent runs.

groups.ln: A. LN Engineering: machining package and in-house parts
groups.porsche-pn: B. Buy by Porsche part number, best price
groups.not-needed: D. Not needed for this build
groups.aftermarket: E. Aftermarket, by vendor (not Porsche numbers)

lines.name: Nickies 101 mm billet aluminium NSC-plated cylinders, installed in your block (block process, all six)
lines.note: The 3.6 to 4.0 conversion. 106-996.101.CD is the closed-deck version with resurfacing; LN says closed deck is not needed for a normally aspirated engine. LN decks and measures the block and machines the sealant grooves as part of the process.
lines.source: LN Engineering M96/M97 Nickies Program 2026, conversion table and SKU list

lines.name: 3.6 to 4.0 911 101 mm CP-Carrillo piston set, rings, pins and clips, 12:1 CR
lines.note: The only 3.6-to-4.0 piston set in the 2026 program. Ask LN about compression ratio and fuel before confirming; 12:1 is their listed spec. Ring end gaps can be pre-set by LN (ring gapping service).

lines.name: Custom 101 mm head gasket set, sold as a pair, thickness chosen by LN after decking (.032, .040 or .060 in)
lines.note: In-house LN part. Replaces the stock 996 104 201 04. LN picks the thickness from the deck measurement.
lines.source: LN Nickies Program 2026, custom head gaskets

lines.name: Connecting rod set for the 3.6/3.8, LN Spec Carrillo or K1/Boostline, 6 rods with bolts
lines.note: LN: upgrading the rods is required when displacement goes up. Aftermarket rods bring their own bolts, so the OEM rod bolts and ARP 204-6301 drop out. LN balances the rotating assembly with the new pistons.

lines.name: IMS Solution for single-row IMS, MY00-05
lines.price_source: LN list, Sept 2026 (parts.json)
lines.note: Pressure-fed plain bearing, no service interval. Includes the flange, seals and the spin-on filter adapter line. LN manual LIB-0027 gives the torques.

lines.name: Inspect intermediate shaft for runout, recondition, pin the sprocket, install the bearing
lines.note: LN recommends pinning the main timing gear on every rebuild. Do it while the shaft is with the block.

lines.name: Crankshaft: magnetic particle inspection and journal polish; rotating assembly balance
lines.note: Send the crank with the block. Bearing size follows from the polish.

lines.name: Cylinder head remanufacture: multi-angle Serdi valve job, guides, Viton stem seals, diamond-milled surfaces (optional, decide after inspection)
lines.note: Covers valve guides, stem seals, valve springs and seats in one line. If the heads measure good, skip it and buy stem seals 996 105 115 52 only.

lines.name: Lightweight flywheel and clutch kit: FCP Euro 996CLUTCHKT, Sachs Performance clutch with Aasco billet aluminium single-mass flywheel
lines.note: FCP kit 996CLUTCHKT: Sachs Performance clutch kit with the Aasco lightweight billet aluminium single-mass flywheel, ships in one business day. Other FCP pages show 2,185.08 and a 996CLUTCHKT1 variant at 2,005.09; check live. Alternatives at FCP: Aasco 106425-12-PKG billet steel flywheel with Sachs Performance clutch, 2,626.00, needs the OE flywheel bolts; Sachs 95011602303KT2 OE-style clutch with Aasco billet steel flywheel, pilot bearing and rear main seal, 2,258.24. The listings are for the 911 (996) in general; confirm 3.6 l fitment and what the kit includes (bolts, torque plate, pilot bearing) before ordering. Flywheel bolt torque per the kit sheet. This kit replaces the separate clutch repair kit line in group B.

The page says it takes the stock disc or the Sachs spring-hub sport disc 88 1861 999 856, and that the bolt torque is 60 ft-lb; the Aasco installation sheet, now in Drive, says 55 ft-lb / 75 Nm for the M10 x 1.0 bolt and governs. price_note: Prices marked FCP Euro retail are from indexed product pages seen on 2026-11-23 unless marked live. Jack's FCP account shows a wholesale price about 10 % under retail (seen live: 1,558.62 retail, 1,396.88 wholesale on 996TIMINGKT2). SSF is usually about 10 % under FCP wholesale, so the SSF estimate is retail x 0.896 x 0.9. Live quotes come from the price agent. Rusnak estimate = Porsche list x 0.8 (Jack's wholesale account). List prices are from indexed Gaudin pages and differ between pages on some parts.
